page_title: RSO 1-0 VAL | Real Sociedad v Valencia 16/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Sergi Canos (Valencia) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Cesar Soto Grado's book.
90+4' Real Sociedad take a short corner kick.
90+4' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Real Sociedad.

90+3' Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off a great save to deny Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the top right corner. Real Sociedad earn a corner.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and Alberto Mari (Valencia) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
90' Andre Almeida (Valencia) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

89' Jose Gaya (Valencia) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Valencia.
88' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Cesar Soto Grado signals. Valencia are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
87' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
86' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Valencia was in an offside position.
85' Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul after Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Valencia have a free kick.
85' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Diego Lopez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Selim Amallah (Valencia).
84' Sergi Canos (Valencia) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

83' Cesar Soto Grado interrupts the game. One of the players from Real Sociedad won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Valencia win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

83' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
83' Today's match ends for Kieran Tierney who will be replaced by Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad).

82' Jose Gaya (Valencia) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Cesar Soto Grado with no other option than to blow for a foul. Real Sociedad are awarded a free kick.
81' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
75' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
75' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alvaro Odriozola leaves the pitch and Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) comes on.
75' Imanol Alguacil prepares a substitution. Andre Silva is replaced by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad).
74' A cross into the box from Jose Gaya (Valencia) is cleared. Corner kick. Valencia will have an opportunity.

72' Alex Remiro makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Alberto Mari (Valencia) inside the box and he drills a strike goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the target.
72' Sergi Canos (Valencia) quickly picks up the rebound and drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him.
71' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hugo Gonzalez (Valencia) replacing Peter Federico.
71' It's time for a substitution. Alberto Mari (Valencia) comes on in place of Roman Yaremchuk.
71' Referee Cesar Soto Grado sees the trip by Alvaro Odriozola (Real Sociedad) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Valencia earn a free kick.
69' Half-chance! Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) plays a pass into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili reacts well to snuff out the attack.
68' Diego Lopez (Valencia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Remiro intercepts the ball.

67' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Giorgi Mamardashvili easily catches the ball.
66' Jose Gaya (Valencia) is able to continue to play.
65' Jose Gaya (Valencia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
65' Jose Gaya (Valencia) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. A free kick has been awarded to Real Sociedad.
64' Diego Lopez (Valencia) commits a rough challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Real Sociedad.
60' Here comes a substitution. Javi Guerra is given a rest as he is replaced by Sergi Canos (Valencia).
60' It is time for a substitution. Jose Gaya (Valencia) is on for Thierry Correia.
60' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Arsen Zakharyan and he is replaced by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad).
60' Substitution. Ander Barrenetxea leaves the pitch and is replaced by Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad).

60' Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Cesar Soto Grado blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Real Sociedad are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
59' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends in a cross from the free kick which goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
59' A player from Valencia commits a rough challenge. Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Real Sociedad have a free kick.
56' Peter Federico (Valencia) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
55' Thierry Correia (Valencia) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
53' Thierry Correia (Valencia) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
52' Thierry Correia (Valencia) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
52' A pass by Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
50' Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) was too forceful with his tackle and Cesar Soto Grado interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Real Sociedad have been awarded a free kick.
46' The attendance is 25067.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' 1 additional min. will be played.
45+1' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul after Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) hacks down one of his opponents. Real Sociedad will take a free kick.
44' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
44' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
43' Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) jumps into a tackle and Cesar Soto Grado signals a foul. Free kick. Real Sociedad will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
42' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. A free kick to Valencia.
42' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
38' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
36' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

36' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the right post.
36' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
33' A pass by Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
32' Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
31' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
29' Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Cesar Soto Grado ignores the protests.
29' Half-chance! Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad) plays a pass into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili reacts well to snuff out the attack.
29' A cross from Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
27' Andre Almeida (Valencia) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Real Sociedad get a free kick.
25' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) tackles a bit over-zealously and Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Valencia, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
20' A rebound falls kindly for Javi Guerra (Valencia), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
20' Peter Federico (Valencia) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
18' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle. Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) commits a foul after dangerous play. Real Sociedad have a free kick.
16' Andre Almeida (Valencia) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

15' Javi Guerra (Valencia) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Valencia have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
13' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
12' A clumsy foul by Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Real Sociedad, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
10' Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
8' Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! There is a free kick near the sideline to Valencia.
7' Valencia are ruled offside.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) makes the score 1:0 after burying a close-range header in the middle of the goal after a good run and cross by Takefusa Kubo.
